text:
Jon (Sales): FYI passing Acuvera over to CS — pre-signed; 250 seats, looking to go-live W/C 2025-06-09. Main asks: SSO (SAML), VPC private deploy w/ dedicated GPUs, and an annual commit. They also want token-level billing exports into their finance system. No production data yet, but they'll run PII in evals soon. Please own the onboarding and surface any infra blockers.

Maya (CS): Thanks Jon — quick q: who owns SSO config on their side? and is there an expected traffic profile (rps / concurrent users)?

Jon (Sales): Contact is Priya (Acuvera IT). She’s agreed to do SAML metadata exchange. Expected peak: ~30 concurrent users during initial pilot, ramp to ~300 over 3 months. They asked for <150ms p50 token latency target.

Maya (CS): Noted. Key risks: private deploy + SSO + dedicated GPUs = infra lead time. I'll schedule an enablement call with Acuvera + infra/eng. Tentative owners: Maya (onboarding lead), Tariq (support escalation), Olivia (eng infra), Jon (sales exec sponsor).

Tariq (Support): Adding: we should create a triage Miro + runbook for SSO cert rotation and private deploy network checklist. I'll open a support ticket and link it here. Also flagging that Dedicated capacity requires a 2-week provisioning lead time for the requested GPU type.

Olivia (Eng): Quick note on the dedicated pool: model selection/quantization will affect GPU sizing. If they want Llama2-70B float16 we need 8xA100-80GB equiv; with q4_k or 4-bit quant we can get by with 4xA100. Can we confirm model choices before provisioning? Also need info on expected max sequence length — that changes memory planning.

Maya (CS): Action list I'm capturing: 1) Setup kickoff with Acuvera + infra (owner: Maya) 2) Create support ticket + runbook (owner: Tariq) 3) Confirm model & seq length with customer (owner: Jon -> Priya) 4) Billing export spec (owner: Maya + Billing ops) 5) Provision dedicated pool (owner: Olivia once model confirmed) 6) Prep enablement deck + SSO config checklist (owner: Maya)

Jon (Sales): I'll ask Priya today to confirm model family and sequence expectations. I'll also get the legal PO cadence for the annual commit.

onboard-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-7182 — "Acuvera private deploy + SSO triage" assigned to Tariq.

Tariq (Support): Created a preliminary runbook snippet in the ticket: ```- Validate SAML metadata exchange (IdP SP)
- Confirm cert rotation window
- Configure ingress rules for VPC peering
- Test prefix/KV cache behavior for 2k seq
- Escalation: ping @olivia for infra constraints``` Please add anything else.

Maya (CS): I added an onboarding calendar invite for 2025-05-28 16:00 PT with Acuvera + Olivia + Tariq + Jon. Also attaching initial enablement slide link: https://redwood.docs/internal/onboarding/acuv-era (please review before call).

Olivia (Eng): I'll validate GPU lead time and post a provisioning ETA in SUP-7182 by EOD tomorrow. If they confirm a 70B float model we should expect 10 business days to provision equivalent capacity.

Jon (Sales): Thanks — flagging renewal signal: customer asked about annual discount tiers and quoted it as part of negotiation. Maya — can you capture renewal timeline in the account health doc and set a renewal touch in 9 months?

Maya (CS): Will do. I'll add a "renewal watch" tag and set calendar cadence (90d/180d/270d) in SFDC. Also will collect feedback after the pilot for product team (tagging @olivia for potential perf regressions).

Jon (Sales): Perfect. Anything else? :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): One more ask — Priya wants a short checklist we can send to their IT for SAML. I'll draft a 1-page checklist and post it here before EOD.

Tariq (Support): I'll link SUP-7182 and add runbook ownership in the ticket. After kickoff we'll convert ad-hoc notes into a persistent internal doc.

Olivia (Eng): I'll add model/quantization recommendations to the ticket and suggest default profiles for cost vs latency tradeoffs.

Maya (CS): Great — owners confirmed. Closing this handoff thread, but keep updates in SUP-7182 and the onboarding calendar.
